name: Harlow Main Office
summary: Our first office, open since 1958. Full service, drive-thru, safe deposit boxes and the mortgage team.
lobby_hours:
Mon to Fri, 9 am to 5 pm
Sat, 9 am to noon
drive_hours:
Mon to Fri, 8 am to 6 pm
Sat, 9 am to 1 pm
services: Drive-thru, Safe deposit boxes, Notary, Coin counter, Mortgage team, 24-hour ATM
about:
The Harlow Main Office opened in 1958 in a room above the feed store, and moved to Main Street in 1971. It is still where the board meets and where most of our mortgage and business lending team works.

Free parking is behind the building, with accessible spaces by the side door. The drive-thru has three lanes and a 24-hour ATM that takes deposits.

name: Millbrook Springs
summary: A full-service branch by the high school, with Saturday hours and a student banking desk.
lobby_hours:
Mon to Fri, 9 am to 5:30 pm
Sat, 9 am to 1 pm
drive_hours: Mon to Fri, 8 am to 6 pm
services: Drive-thru, Student banking desk, Coin counter, 24-hour ATM
about: Our Millbrook Springs branch sits across from Millbrook High School. Students can open a first checking account with a parent at the student desk after school.

name: Copper Flats
summary: Small business lending, a walk-up ATM and a community meeting room members can book.
lobby_hours: Mon to Fri, 9 am to 5 pm
services: Business lending, Community room, Notary, 24-hour ATM
about: The Copper Flats branch is home to our business services team. The community room seats 40 and is free for local nonprofits; call the branch to book it.

about: Wren Lake opened in May 2025. It has two private rooms for home loan and retirement conversations, and a video banking kiosk that connects you to a member advisor in Harlow.
